name: Pettoshoppu
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood pet shop, Wannyan Hiroba: a new training-consultation corner notice, a first day helping at the shop, a grooming reservation guide, a trial small-animal corner notice, a new-hire training plan comparison, a column about learning from a regular dog's change in gait, a lesson teaching a new kouhai how to stock pet food safely, an explainer on why staff consultation is still needed in the online-ordering era, a lost-pet ID tag service application guide, a column on how online reservations changed grooming reception work, a new rule for busy-season grooming bookings, a column on the meaning of a veteran staff member's skill for sensing a pet's change in condition, and a one-year cooperation report with a local animal welfare group. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
